D18.text: The arms cannot get model access in a Claude cloud session. Q9's suggested route (a network secret for api.anthropic.com) does not exist: the secure form refuses Anthropic hosts because the session authenticates itself, and the session's own token must not be handed to an arm that runs with permissions bypassed.
